先猜一猜，再动手: Make a guess, then try it
画面和真实大小、时间不成比例。: Sizes and times in the picture are not to scale.
换个条件，再看一次: Change a condition and look again
雨水落到地上以后呢？: What happens to rain on the ground?
给不同的地面下一场雨，看看水流走了、渗下去了，还是留下来了。: Rain on different surfaces. Does the water run off, soak in, or stay?
地面有小空隙，水可能从那里钻进去。: Water can enter small spaces in the ground.
入渗取决于孔隙连通性、初始含水量、降雨强度等。沙土通常入渗较快，但饱和后同样可能: Infiltration depends on connected pores, initial moisture, rainfall intensity and other conditions. Sand commonly infiltrates quickly but can produce runoff when saturated; cracked clay can also admit water rapidly. Fixed illustrative fractions support comparison here, rather than soil measurement or flood prediction.
水滴是等量示意单位，画面剖面放大了土粒与空隙。只画雨后的一小段时间，不计算蒸发与: Drops represent equal illustrative units. The cross-section enlarges soil grains and pores. Only a short period after rainfall is shown; evaporation and later groundwater flow are omitted.
同样一场雨落在不同的地面上，结果会不同。先选沙土、黏土或者铺好的石板。: The same rain can behave differently on different ground. Choose sand, compact clay or paving stone.
水可以沿着土粒之间相连的空隙向下渗。沙土通常比紧实的黏土更容易让水通过。: Water can soak down through connected spaces between soil grains. Sandy soil usually lets water pass more readily than compact clay.
当雨来得比地面吸收得更快时，水可能积起来，也可能沿坡向旁边流走。石板表面很难透水: If rain arrives faster than the ground absorbs it, water can collect or run downhill. Paving stone lets little water through its surface.
雨水不会凭空消失：这份示意把水分为渗入、流走和暂时积留三部分。真实土壤的干湿程度: The water does not disappear. This illustration divides it into infiltration, runoff and temporary storage. Real results also depend on soil moisture, cracks and plants.
黄色圈：同一份雨水；虚线：流走的路线: Gold marker: the same parcel; dashed line: runoff route
100 份是示意总量，不是雨量测量: 100 symbolic parts, not a rainfall measurement
